description: The 2026 Ford Bronco Heritage Edition is finished in Velocity Blue Metallic Paint and fitted with a ReadyLIFT 3" that raises the stance with fabricated upper control arms and a rear track bar bracket, along with a four wheel alignment. It rides on American Racing 17 inch wheels in full polished aluminum and BFGoodrich 37X12.50R17 Mud-Terrain KM3 tires, and it carries a Retro Build that includes professionally installed window tint with a lifetime warranty, custom Katskin leather seats, matching door panels and center console lid, a custom retro vinyl banner, custom retro Bronco badging, and paint-matched fender flares, bumpers, hood, and handles. Equipment Group 662A is included, along with Lane Keep Assist, Wi-Fi Hotspot, Collision Warning, Navigation, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and a 50-State Emissions System.The Heritage Edition treatment gives the Bronco a familiar shape with details that reference earlier versions of the nameplate while keeping the truck rooted in current hardware. The blue exterior finish is paired with the corrected proportions from the suspension , which gives the body more clearance around the larger tire package without changing the vehicle's recognizable two-door profile or boxy lines. The polished wheels add a bright contrast against the dark tread blocks, and the flares, bumpers, hood, and handles are matched to the body color as part of the custom work, so the exterior surfaces read more uniformly from panel to panel. The retro badging and vinyl banner are part of the same treatment, and they are integrated in a way that keeps the appearance consistent with the rest of the build rather than layered on as separate accents.Inside, the cabin receives its own set of revisions through the custom Katskin leather seats, with matching work carried through the door panels and center console lid. The tinted glass is already installed and backed by a lifetime warranty, which is one of the few added items here that comes with a specific service promise attached to it. The cabin presentation remains practical, but the added trim materials give the interior a more finished feel than the standard surfaces alone. The Bronco's factory technology is present as well, including the navigation system, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and the Wi-Fi Hotspot function, all of which are grouped with the broader Equipment Group 662A package. Lane Keep Assist and Collision Warning are included too, and the 50-State Emissions System is fitted so the vehicle is ready for registration across the country.The chassis changes are the most direct modification to the vehicle's road and trail stance. The 3" ReadyLIFT package adds height without pushing the Bronco into an extreme build, and the fabricated upper control arms and rear track bar bracket are the supporting pieces that go with a properly corrected suspension . The alignment work is part of the installation, which matters when the suspension geometry is changed and the wheel and tire package is larger than stock. The 37-inch BFGoodrich mud-terrain tires add a substantial contact patch and more sidewall than the factory tires, while the 17 inch American Racing wheels provide the mounting surface in a polished finish that contrasts with the more utilitarian tread pattern. Those elements work together to give the Bronco a taller stance and a more purpose-built road presence without relying on additional bodywork or cosmetic add-ons beyond what is already included in the build.On the road, the Bronco is supported by the electronics and driver-assist items already fitted from the factory, so the vehicle is not just a visual restyle. Navigation is built in, smartphone integration is covered through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and the Wi-Fi Hotspot provides connected capability when the vehicle is in use. Lane Keep Assist and Collision Warning add a layer of factory safety content that remains part of the equipment list regardless of the exterior work. The 50-State Emissions System keeps the powertrain compliant for use in all states, and the Heritage Edition treatment gives the truck a distinct visual identity through the paint-matched exterior pieces, retro badging, and interior trim work.----We Know You Will Enjoy Your Trucks Test Drive Towards Ownership! The multi-touch infotainment display provides straightforward access to radio, navigation, and smartphone integration through wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto.  Safety features include standard four-wheel disc brakes, electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system. The all-season tires and four-wheel independent suspension support confident handling across varying road conditions. OnStar connectivity and GMC Connected Services capability provide additional peace of mind.  The three-row layout seats up to seven passengers, making this Acadia adaptable for families, group outings, or daily commuting. The flexible interior accommodates both passengers and cargo depending on your immediate needs. With remote start and automatic high-beam headlights, daily conveniences simplify routine operation. description: This 2022 Nissan Frontier S is a capable truck ready to handle your work and lifestyle demands with proven reliability and practical design.  - Rear Automatic Braking (RAB) - Blind Spot Warning (BSW) - Lane Departure Warning (LDW) - Rear Cross Traffic Alert (RCTA) - High Beam Assist (HBA) - Intelligent Cruise Control (ICC) - Rear Sonar System - 3.8L DOHC V6 Engine - 9-Speed Automatic Transmission - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto Integration - SiriusXM Satellite Radio with 6-Speaker Audio - Electronic Stability Control with Traction Control - Front Bucket Seats with Cloth Trim  The 3.8L V6 engine delivers dependable power paired with a 9-speed automatic transmission, achieving 18 MPG city and 24 MPG highway. This combination provides the torque you need while maintaining reasonable fuel economy for a truck in its class. The rear-wheel drive configuration enhances maneuverability and control in varied driving conditions.  Gray exterior paint over front bucket seating creates a practical interior designed for long hours behind the wheel. The cloth trim is durable and easy to maintain, while the tilt steering wheel and split folding rear seat provide flexibility for both passengers and cargo. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity keep you linked to your smartphone, and the SiriusXM-equipped audio system with six speakers delivers consistent entertainment.  Safety technology is a priority on this Frontier. The comprehensive suite includes blind spot warning, lane departure warning, rear cross traffic alert, and rear automatic brakingsystems designed to help you navigate traffic and parking situations with greater confidence. High beam assist automatically switches between high and low beams, and the rear sonar system provides added awareness when backing up.  Additional features include automatic headlights, a rearstep bumper, electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system with dual front impact, dual front side impact, and knee airbags. The 8-way adjustable driver's seat with power lumbar support allows you to find your ideal driving position, while heated front seats add warmth during colder months. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and rear side impact airbags provide comprehensive protection. If you're looking for smooth-riding luxury with a practical twist, the RX is a great option. While it's not quite the cargo-hauling champ, the RX came close, holding just one less carry-on suitcase behind its rear seats than the victorious Cadillac XT5. With its second row folded, a process done either from the side door or from the cargo area, the RX matched the XT5 with 24 cases. Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and onboard Wi-Fi are all included. An 8.0-inch infotainment touchscreen comes standard, but upgrading to the 12.3-inch display not only provides a wider viewing screen, it also adds in-dash navigation, a 12-speaker audio system (a nine-speaker setup is standard), a DVD/CD player, and access to the Lexus Enform App Suite. This collection of apps provides access to emergency assistance as well as limited internet connectivity from the infotainment system. With its combination of impressive attention to detail, interior appointments and practicality, the 2022 Lexus RX 350 has long been an attractive proposition in the luxury SUV scene. How comfortable is the RX 350? Comfort is paramount in a Lexus, and the RX 350 is generally excellent. Hows the interior? Even though the base of the windshield looks to be pretty far away, the dashboard and all major controls fall easily to hand. The buttons are on the large side, clearly labeled and easy to press, and most everything you touch feels well engineered and well considered. All passengers will appreciate the large square door openings, and there's plenty of room for tall people in the front and the back. Even the panoramic sunroof doesn't take away much headroom. Driver aids are well calibrated, and we didn't have any false alarms or overreactions. Fit and finish on the RX 350 leaves almost nothing to be desired, both inside and out. It's a rare moment when you come in contact with something other than leather or soft-touch plastics. Many manufacturers lack this level of attention to detail. description: This 2022 Subaru Ascent Touring in silver is a three-row family vehicle ready to serve your household with reliable performance and thoughtful design.  - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration - Third row seating for up to eight passengers - Clean one-owner Carfax history - AWD capability for confident handling - Backup camera for parking assistance - Bluetooth connectivity - Push button engine start - Harman/Kardon premium audio system - Subaru STARLINK 8.0" multimedia navigation - Power liftgate for easy cargo access - Heated and ventilated front bucket seats - All-weather floor liners - Auto-dimming exterior mirror with approach light - Aero crossbar set for roof storage options - 20" alloy wheels with dark gray finish  The Ascent was built to accommodate modern family life. Its three rows of seating provide flexibility whether you're transporting a full passenger load or maximizing cargo space. The third row includes reclining seats and a sunshade, while the second row features split-folding capability to adapt to your needs. Climate control reaches all three rows with front dual-zone air conditioning and rear air conditioning, ensuring comfort for everyone on board.  Technology and convenience are woven throughout this Touring model. The Subaru STARLINK system offers an 8-inch touchscreen with navigation, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you connected to your smartphone. The harman/kardon audio system delivers quality sound through 14 speakers. Bluetooth connectivity, SiriusXM radio, and steering wheel audio controls make staying connected seamless during your drive.  Safety features include dual front impact airbags, side-impact airbags, knee airbag, and overhead airbag placement. Electronic stability control and traction control work together with four-wheel independent suspension to help maintain secure footing on varied road conditions. The backup camera and parking assistance support your awareness, while auto high-beam headlights and rain-sensing wipers respond to changing conditions.  Comfort amenities enhance daily driving. Heated and ventilated front seats maintain your preferred temperature, while the heated steering wheel adds warmth during cold months. Memory seat settings allow you to save your preferred driving position. The power liftgate opens with a button press, and the power moonroof brings light and air to the cabin. Dual-zone automatic temperature control lets front passengers set independent comfort levels.  This Ascent has been maintained as a single-owner vehicle with a clean history. With approximately 67,000 miles, it delivers strong fuel efficiency at 20 city and 26 highway MPG, thanks to the 2.4L four-cylinder engine paired with Lineartronic CVT automatic transmission and all-wheel drive. The Popular Package #2A adds practical touches including a cargo tray, splash guards, and a rear bumper cover. Trailer light check, reverse steering control, brake control, and tire pressure monitoring work together to make towing safer and more manageable. The anti-spin differential rear axle provides additional confidence when managing heavy loads.  This red Laramie comes equipped to serve both work and leisure purposes.
